# `title-changed`

Title changed

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `docs` |
| **Default severity** | `info` |
| **Rule IDs** | `title-changed` |
| **Status** | Implemented (M5) |
| **Group** | Docs (annotations only) ([RULES.md section 10](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

A `title` outside schemas changed (schema titles are `schema-title-changed`).

## Why this default

Documentation only.

## Example

From test case [`title-changed`](../../test/cases/title-changed/): The document's info.title changed.

`openapi.yaml`, base → revision:

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info:
-   title: Pets
+   title: Pet Store
    version: 1.0.0
  paths:
```

Findings:

- `title-changed` · info · document

## Test cases

The example above is the only test case for this rule.


## Policy options

Every rule takes `severity` (`error`, `warn`, `info` or `off`), `fix` and `explanation` in the policy file. The policy file arrives in M6; see [POLICY.md](../../POLICY.md).

```yaml
rules:
  title-changed: info
```
